text:
maria: Heads up — Acme emailed legal and sales today: they added a new module to their reserved capacity contract effective 3/10, mid-billing period. They want it invoiced now but sales says it should be treated as an amendment to the existing annual prepay.
aj: Do we have the amendment doc? If it increases total consideration we need to evaluate contract modification under ASC 606.
maria: Sales uploaded the signed amendment to SFDC (opp id 00432). It increases ARR by $120k, term unchanged. They want the extra invoiced immediately and apply a one-time onboarding fee credit on next month.
leo: If term unchanged and distinct goods/services, it's a separate contract; but since it's an amendment to an existing contract, we need to check whether the additional goods are distinct. Practically, I think we should allocate the $120k over the remaining term unless it's clearly a separate deliverable.
sarah: For month-end close I need journal guidance. Current deferred revenue for the account is a monthly amort schedule. If we recognize the $120k over remaining 10 months, revenue per month is $12k. If they invoice now but we treat as deferred, we need a deferral schedule update and reversal entries.
maria: Finance Ops — can you prepare the invoice but tag it as "Invoice: Amendment - defer per revrec" so billing won't push to AR immediately? We can also issue a one-line credit memo for the onboarding fee next month.
aj: Billing can't lock an invoice to defer posting; accounting needs a manual memo to AP/AR to hold posting. Alternatively we can create an invoice and immediately record a deferred revenue liability. Which do we prefer?
leo: Record the invoice to AR, then book deferred revenue. That preserves audit trail. Journal would be: 
```
Dr Accounts Receivable: 120,000
Cr Deferred Revenue - Contract Amendments: 120,000
```
Then monthly amortization: 
```
Dr Deferred Revenue - Contract Amendments: 12,000
Cr Revenue - Hosted Services: 12,000
```
Adjustments for onboarding fee credit to be applied next month: create a separate payable/credit memo when invoice is issued.
sarah: Can you confirm the deferral account name and dimension (revenue_schedule_id)? I need to update the revenue schedule feed before close today.
leo: Use rev_sched_2026_003 for this customer, dimension = customer_acme_00432, product = reserved_capacity. I'll DM the revrec-bot to provision the schedule.
revrec-bot: Provision request received for rev_sched_2026_003. Expected schedule created with 10 lines of amortization, start_date=2026-03-10, frequency=monthly.
maria: Perfect. Sarah, once revrec-bot confirms, post the AR journal and push the deferred schedule. I'll notify sales and tag the customer.
sarah: On it. Posting AR journal now and attaching amendment PDF to the JE. I will also add comment to the close checklist: "Amendment - Acme: deferred $120k over 10 months; onboarding fee credit memo to be created for next month."
aj: Thanks. One more: we had an open pricing experiment discount applied incorrectly on Feb invoices for this cohort. Could that affect the contract amendment allocation?
leo: If the experiment affected the standalone selling price for items in scope, we need to reallocate transaction price. For now the amendment is a discrete price increase; experiment shouldn't retroactively change it. But please list impacted invoices so accounting can run a reconciliation.
maria: I'll compile a list of impacted invoices and the amendment doc, push to the shared close folder, and mark this thread resolved when done. :white_check_mark: 
sarah: Done. JE posted, schedule in system, and note added to month-end tracker. Closing loop with sales for credit memo.
aj: Thanks team. If auditors ask, we have JE, amendment in SFDC, and revenue schedule export. :thumbsup:
